description: This Java class defines Swagger API documentation models for floating rate resources within the Apache Fineract project. It includes nested classes for request and response schemas related to floating rate operations, with annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.

classes.name: FloatingRatesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes that define API request and response schema models for floating rate endpoints, annotated with Swagger Schema annotations.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesRequest
classes.description: Schema model for creating a new floating rate, including its properties and nested rate periods.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesRatePeriods
classes.description: Schema model for a rate period within a floating rate, including date, interest rate, locale, and date format.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a floating rate, mainly returning a resource ID.

classes.name: GetFloatingRatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving floating rate details, including identification, creation/modification info, and status flags.

classes.name: PutFloatingRatesFloatingRateIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for updating a floating rate, including resource ID and changed properties.

classes.name: PutFloatingRatesChanges
classes.description: Schema detailing specific changes to a floating rate, primarily its rate periods.
